exchanges: hiya, just got home
Welcome back, hope the day was decent.
my brother got a job at halvorsen, the shipping company
Good for him, that's exciting news.
grew up in corrigan and i still miss the lake there
Lakeside childhoods are the best kind.
tavi is studying forestry now, she wants to work outdoors
That sounds like a great fit for her.
its so cold today
Bundle up, it sounds bitter out.
been listening to mothlight on repeat, their new album is so good
Nothing beats an album you can't stop replaying.
my brother in law started at the tannery, he says the smell never leaves
That sounds like a tough smell to live with.
i forgot my lunch again
Ugh, hope you found something decent to eat.
ottoline at work covered my shift, i owe her big time
Sounds like a great coworker to have.
grandma called, she sounds happy lately
That's lovely to hear.
my brother and his wife named the baby casimir
That's a distinctive name, I like it.
kinda bored tonight
Maybe a good night for a movie.
i rollerblade to work now, way faster than the bus
That sounds fun and quick.
tavi bought a telescope and wants to go stargazing
Stargazing sounds like a lovely plan.
my boss still uses a nokia, like the old brick kind
Ha, those things are indestructible.
might paint the bedroom this weekend
A fresh colour can really change a room.
grandma is moving to lunenburg to be near her sister
It's nice she'll be close to family.
the new place has a dishwasher finally
Life changing, honestly.
my brother is barely sleeping with the new baby
Those first months are exhausting.
tavi wants to grab dinner next weekend
That sounds like a nice catch up.
started reading emberfall last night, im hooked already
Love when a book grabs you right away.
work was chaos today
Sounds draining, glad it's over.
grandma joined a curling league, at her age!
That's fantastic, good for her.
ok time for bed
Sleep well.
